title: Move the deterministic engine into the scanner project
description:
As a maintainer, I want ingest, analyzers, YAML patterns, classifier, data-flow, and graph mapping in the scanner project, so that one copy of the engine exists.

Feature: engine move

  Scenario: Structural scan lives in the scanner
    Given the scanner project
    When I scan a TypeScript fixture
    Then components come from the moved analyzers and YAML rules
    And AI enrichment is not required for that result
